notes.en: Adds a Usage dashboard, restores saved console workspaces and conversations, and improves session navigation and terminal resize handling.
notes.zh-CN: 新增 Usage 用量面板，恢复已保存的控制台工作区与会话，并改进会话导航和终端尺寸变化处理。

notes.en: Displays image files in hosted editor tabs and image changes in Git review panes, with updated editor and Git viewer companions.
notes.zh-CN: 在托管编辑器标签页中显示图像文件，在 Git 审阅窗格中显示图像变更，并更新随附的编辑器和 Git 查看器。

notes.en: Cross-compiled zai CLI packages built from one pinned source revision.
notes.zh-CN: 由同一份固定源代码修订版交叉编译出的 zai CLI 安装包。

notes.en: Release archives are published publicly while the application source stays private.
notes.zh-CN: 应用源代码保持私有，仅公开发布安装包。

notes.en: Every archive is unsigned; verify the SHA-256 shown on the download page.
notes.zh-CN: 所有压缩包均未签名；请核对下载页显示的 SHA-256 校验值。

installNotes.en: Unsigned build. Install with the one-line installer, which verifies this archive's SHA-256. To install manually, extract the whole archive and run 'python3 install.py' ('python install.py' on Windows) from the extracted folder. Python 3.10 or newer is required to install; install your coding-agent CLI separately before using it with zai.
installNotes.zh-CN: 未签名的构建。建议使用一行安装命令，它会校验该压缩包的 SHA-256。如需手动安装，请完整解压后在解压目录运行 “python3 install.py”（Windows 上为 “python install.py”）。安装需要 Python 3.10 及以上；请另行安装所需的编程代理 CLI。
